component.name: NeoSzyszka
component.summary: Simple but powerful file renamer, written in Rust

description.p: NeoSzyszka is a simple, fast and powerful file renamer written in Rust.
This is a fork of the original Szyszka by Rafał Mikrut, rewritten with GTK 4 and libadwaita (GNOME HIG compliant) and maintained as NeoSzyszka by Sam-Fic.
New features, stability improvements, and cross-platform distribution:

ul.li: Cross-platform packages: automatically publish a Linux Flatpak, Windows portable package, and macOS disk images for Intel and Apple Silicon (跨平台安装包：自动发布 Linux Flatpak、Windows 便携包，以及 Intel 和 Apple Silicon macOS 磁盘镜像)

GNOME visual consistency: bundle the complete Adwaita icon theme and hicolor fallback theme on Windows and macOS, so symbolic icons match the GNOME experience (GNOME 视觉一致性：Windows 和 macOS 随包提供完整 Adwaita 图标主题及 hicolor 回退主题，符号图标与 GNOME 保持一致)
Native application icons: add multi-resolution Windows executable and package icons plus macOS Finder and Dock icons (原生应用图标：新增多分辨率 Windows 可执行文件与安装包图标，以及 macOS Finder 和 Dock 图标)
Rule editing: edit existing rules directly and receive clear feedback when no rule is selected (规则编辑：可直接编辑已有规则，未选择规则时提供清晰提示)
Safer batch renaming: use an inline progress indicator and prevent duplicate rename operations (更安全的批量重命名：采用内联进度指示，并防止重复执行重命名操作)
Localization and list behavior: improve translations and make file and rule reordering reliable (本地化与列表行为：改进翻译，并使文件和规则的重新排序更加可靠)

description.p: First release of this fork, rebuilt on GTK 4 and libadwaita:

ul.li: Rewritten UI with GTK 4 and libadwaita, following the GNOME Human Interface Guidelines
Modernized main window with adaptive layout, native file/rule list views and sorting
Added drag-and-drop support for adding files
Added a progress dialog for renaming operations
Bundled the app icon as a GResource and added an About dialog
Added desktop entry and AppStream metadata for proper desktop integration
